params.name: organizationId
params.description:
The unique identifier of the target [organization](https://docs.coveo.com/en/185/).
Example: `mycoveocloudv2organizationg8tp8wu3`

params.name: fieldId
params.description:
The `name` property of the field to retrieve.
**Example:** `numberoflikes`

items.docs:
Shows information regarding a single [field](https://docs.coveo.com/en/200/glossary/field) in the [index](https://docs.coveo.com/en/204/glossary/index) of the target [Coveo Cloud organization](https://docs.coveo.com/en/185/).

**Required privilege:** Fields - View

Privilege required ``` {"owner":"PLATFORM","targetDomain":"FIELD","type":"VIEW","targetId":"*"} ```
